verdict.rationale: v0 supports isolated branches and preview deployments that are separate from the production URL, letting changes be reviewed/tested before they affect production (v0-docs-38, v0-docs-39, v0-docs-29, v0-docs-11). However, there is no explicit sandbox/staging environment for data (e.g., a separate database or mock data layer) — integrations like Supabase/Neon/Upstash appear to connect directly to real backend services rather than a sandboxed copy. Missing for 10: explicit data-isolation/sandbox environment separate from production databases, first-party documentation of a test/staging data layer, and independent confirmation that production data is never touched during preview/testing.
